تراحمت (form VI)
# تَرَاحَمْتُ (tarāḥamtu) /ta.raː.ħam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَرَاحَمَ (tarāḥama)
# تَرَاحَمْتَ (tarāḥamta) /ta.raː.ħam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَرَاحَمَ (tarāḥama)
# تَرَاحَمْتِ (tarāḥamti) /ta.raː.ħam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَرَاحَمَ (tarāḥama)
# تَرَاحَمَتْ (tarāḥamat) /ta.raː.ħa.mat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
